clinical_justification: The patient has a primary diagnosis of Dependent drug abuse (SNOMED CT 6525002) which necessitates supervised inpatient detoxification to safely manage withdrawal symptoms and prevent relapse or medical complications. Inpatient drug rehabilitation provides continuous monitoring, medication-assisted therapy, and multidisciplinary support that cannot be reliably delivered in an outpatient setting for an elderly patient (age 82) with potential comorbidities. Therefore, admission for drug rehabilitation and detoxification is medically necessary and aligns with standard clinical practice for severe substance dependence.

citations.section: Suraksha Gold Family Floater Plan (Policy Wording) > 3. Pre-Authorisation > 3.3 Contents of a Pre-Authorisation Request
citations.quote:
### 3.3 Contents of a Pre-Authorisation Request
Diagnosis with code, proposed treatment, estimated cost, expected length of stay, the treating doctor's statement of medical necessity, and supporting investigation reports.

citations.section: Suraksha Gold Family Floater Plan (Policy Wording) > 3. Pre-Authorisation > 3.1 When Pre-Authorisation Is Required
citations.quote:
## 3. Pre-Authorisation  
### 3.1 When Pre-Authorisation Is Required
Prior authorisation is mandatory for (a) every planned In-patient Hospitalisation and (b) any treatment with an estimated cost above ₹50,000.
